scope: Phase 1 text-only eager. Independent CPU reference. The complete campaign also needs a real A5 service.
request_gate: Alias advertised, prompt IDs match, original smoke requires 4/4 exact trimmed contents, status 200, finish_reason=stop, returned alias and nonempty request IDs
trace_policy: Identical prompt IDs and greedy tokens until EOS or step budget, complete prefill and at least two decode steps for the successive-decode probe. Record full logits, top16 and every backbone layer. On divergence retain step, token position, layer, rank and both tensor files.
numerics: No cross-backend floating tolerance supplied. Report exact first differences and per-tensor deltas. Approximate matches alone cannot yield a numeric PASS.
cpu_operator: Read actual FP8 table plus scales of both layers, compare incremental versus whole prompt hashes, reconstruct independent q/k gate and preserve real-weight output under the specified diagnostic residual.
model_integrity: Original shard/index identities are published in hf-source.json. Record what was actually verified in each run. A size/index match alone is not a full-content SHA256 check.
